description_en: This topic describes the syntax and examples of the DeleteImage operation, which is used to delete image information from an Image Search instance
description_zh: 本文为您介绍DeleteImage接口的语法及示例，用于向图像搜索实例中删除图片信息
name: DeleteImage

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Image Search instance. The name can be up to 20 characters in length.
If you have purchased an Image Search instance, log on to the Image Search console (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/) to view the instance name.
If you have not purchased an Image Search instance, refer to https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html and https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html.
The instance name is not the instance ID. The instance name must be unique within the same region. Make sure you distinguish between the two
parameters.help_zh:
图搜实例名称。最多支持20个字符。
如果已经购买图搜实例可登录图像搜索管控台 (https://imagesearch.console.aliyun.com/)查看。
如果没有购买图搜实例可参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/179178.html和https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/66569.html。
这里的实例名称并非实例ID，且实例名称同区域内唯一不可重复，使用时请区分
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The product ID.

A product can have multiple images. 2. If IsDeleteByFilter is set to false, this parameter is required
parameters.help_zh:
商品ID。

1.一个商品可以有多张图片 2.若IsDeleteByFilter字段为false 则此字段必填
parameters.name: product_id

parameters.help_en:
The image name.
If you do not specify this parameter, all images under the specified ProductId are deleted.
If you specify this parameter, the image specified by ProductId and PicName is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
图片名称。
如果不指定本参数，则删除ProductId下所有图片。
如果指定本参数，则删除ProductId+PicName指定的图片
parameters.name: pic_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to delete images based on the Filter field.
If this parameter is set to true, images are deleted based on Filter or Filter+ProductId, and Filter is required. 2. If this parameter is set to false, images are deleted based on ProductId or ProductId+PicName, and ProductId is required
parameters.help_zh:
根据Filter字段去重
1.若为true 则根据Filter或Filter+ProductId删除 且Filter必填。2.若为false 则根据ProductId或者ProductId+PicName进行删除  ProductId必填
parameters.name: is_delete_by_filter

parameters.help_en:
The filter condition. The int_attr field supports the following operators: greater than (>), greater than or equal to (>=), less than (<), less than or equal to (<=), and equal to (=). The str_attr field supports the following operators: equal to (=) and not equal to (!=). Multiple conditions can be connected by using AND and OR.
Examples:
int_attr >= 100.
str_attr != "value1".
int_attr = 1000 AND str_attr = "value1".
A maximum of 4096 characters are supported
parameters.help_zh:
过滤条件。int_attr支持的操作符有大于号(>)、大于等于号(>=)、小于号(<)、小于等于号(<=)、等于号(=)。str_attr支持的操作符有等于号(=)和不等号(!=)，多个条件之支持AND和OR进行连接。
例如：
int_attr >= 100。
str_attr != "value1"。
int_attr = 1000 AND str_attr = "value1"。
最多支持4096个字符
parameters.name: filter

Code.description_en:
The error code. Valid values:
0: success.
Non-zero value: failure
Code.description_zh:
错误码。
0：成功。
非0：失败

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
